product_contract.published_differential: Gamma_d=Gamma_1-Gamma_2=2*N2a, electrostatic control acceleration, not freefall itself
product_contract.physical_sign: Primary2022 PDF10 Eq4 uses delta(2,1) in measured control difference because control acceleration is opposite to gravity acceleration. Do not apply a second sign flip to the fitted coefficient.
product_contract.fitted_readout: delta_x=ac11*delta(2,1); eta_TiPt=delta_x/(ac11*mbar), mbar=(mG2/mI2+mG1/mI1)/2; ac11 and mbar require calibration
product_contract.minimum_product_unit: One accepted SUEP segment with N0c ancillary orbit/attitude/housekeeping, N2a/calibrated output, mask, calibration matrix and noise/uncertainty products
product_contract.raw_archive: NOT_ACQUIRED; official portal timeout is not proof of absence

alternative_contract_proposal.symbols: x=d^2, Delta=qTiAlV-qPtRh, qbar=(qTiAlV+qPtRh)/2, qE/qS full Earth/Sun mass sensitivities; gamma=dU_sun_bare/dU_sun_used
alternative_contract_proposal.domain: x>=0, qE!=0, D=1+qbar*qE*x>0; gamma may depend on x and requires its own ephemeris calibration law; no free fitting of gamma
alternative_contract_proposal.inverse_boundary: Residual is necessary only. Zero source/contrast and singular denominators do not establish feasible inverse images. Full atomic K and source charges with error bounds remain missing.
alternative_contract_proposal.covariance_alternative: Separately justified marginal sets with coverage 1-alpha_i imply simultaneous coverage at least 1-sum(alpha_i) by the union bound without independence. This avoids demanding cross-probe covariance for conservative set consistency only; within-probe calibration, systematic and theory-error coverage are still mandatory.
